hook: The bunker shot that buries you, not the ball.
setting: Standing in a greenside sand bunker with the lip and a flag just beyond, both babies full-body with sand under their feet.
action: Mulligan takes a huge swing and launches a cloud of sand straight up that rains down and covers him completely; the ball never moves. Birdie blinks, coated in sand too.
sound: a whoosh, a sandy spray, a soft patter of falling sand
judge: Explosion wordplay lands cute but the reveal is telegraphed.
